d:
Step into a meditative soundscape where guitar and tabla come together in a soulful rendition of Raga Ahir Bhairav. This studio session blends the melodic phrasing of the guitar with the rhythmic pulse of the tabla, creating a conversation between strings and percussion that unfolds slowly and organically.
Credit's:
Album Name : In Studio : Raga Ahir Bhairav
Artist: Pandit Brij Bhushan Kabra & Ustad Zakir Hussain
